title: Bluelink ReANalysis (BRAN) virtual stores
description: Byte-reference indexes of the Bluelink ReANalysis ocean model output on NCI (project gb6): BRAN2020 before 2010 and BRAN2023 from 2010, one array per variable. No model data is copied; every form reads the original netCDF files from NCI THREDDS. Each dataset is published as a GDAL multidimensional VRT, kerchunk Parquet, an Icechunk repository with virtual references, a flat Parquet refs store and a STAC collection. The terms of use of the model output are those of BRAN (CSIRO, Bluelink) at NCI.
